analysis_unit: same-transect consecutive target year with at least two observations older than the source year
claim_boundary: Post-hoc external ecological replication because NPS response data were previously opened.
Continuous cover prediction is a different endpoint from Tampa recorded-loss early warning.
Node identity is included in every arm, so memory increments are evaluated beyond persistent site differences.
The fixed long-history feature set is not tuned on held-out target years.
interpretation: Immediate previous-year cover carries reproducible out-of-time information beyond persistent site identity and target year. Older history does not provide a robust increment beyond lag-1: it improves only 4/14 target years, has a slightly adverse median year-level delta, and the paired sign-flip test is not supportive. The external NPS system therefore supports short-term quantitative state dependence, not a general long-memory claim.

model.primary_metric: target-year MAE; unweighted macro mean across target years
